skill.summary: Atomic node skill to initialize a Gmail draft with recipients.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release for Gmail Draft Initialize—atomic skill to create Gmail drafts with recipients only.

- Initializes a new Gmail draft with specified recipients (To).
- Does not set subject or body; use separate skills for those fields.
- Implements an autonomous error detection and recovery loop (jidoka).
- Returns a JSON response with the created draft's ID.
